summary: Gold Amulet bought with fractured +3 Melee Skills, finished with Spirit, T1 flat ES (catalysed), desecrated % ES and rarity at 40% defence quality.
benchmarkReason: Explicit minimum counts: the Spirit reroll (7:22-7:37), the Dextral Erasure + Chaos loop 'until you're happy' (10:00-10:37) and the final bone + Omen of Light loop (10:38-10:58) have no stated count, and the catalysed T1 flat ES slam hit first try ('I got fairly lucky', 9:01-9:06). Anchor: 'I think it cost me like 100 divine orbs' (11:18-11:22); whether that includes the bought base is not said (its price never is).

steps: Item level not stated for the amulet: 82 assumed (T1 flat ES needs 80)
Buy a Gold Amulet with fractured +3 Melee Skills (price not stated)
Remove mods and reroll until a Spirit prefix (settled for T2, ~45); roll count not stated
Dextral Exaltation + Exalt a suffix, Dextral Crystallisation + Essence of the Breach removes it and adds +20% max quality
Defence catalysts, Sinistral + Catalysing Exaltation + Perfect Exalt: T1 flat ES first try (misses would be annulled)
Re-apply defence quality, Omen of Whittling + Chaos removes the quality mod (quality stays)
Sinistral Necromancy + bone desecration on a prefix, Exalt fills the suffixes; Omen of Dextral Erasure + Chaos loop on suffixes until rarity + strength (loop count not stated)
Last: bone + Abyssal Echoes, Omen of Light on a miss, until % maximum Energy Shield
Counts are the minimum one-per-step from the video (several loops have no stated count); stated total 'like 100 divine orbs'
